newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-STUTTGART GO TOP OF GERMAN FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STUTTGART GO TOP OF GERMAN FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: VfB Stuttgart dislodged Bayern Munich from the top of the German first division with a 3-1 home victory over Bochum on Saturday.
Stuttgart, who last won the title in 1992 but have struggled to make an impact in recent seasons, took a one point lead over Bayern who slipped to third after a goalless draw at struggling Freiburg.
Bayer Leverkusen took over second spot after a 2-0 victory at Hamburg and are level on points with Stuttgart.
Reigning champions Borussia Dortmund lost ground after a disappointing 1-1 draw at home to Karlsruhe. Dortmund stayed fourth but are now three points behind the leaders.

Stuttgart, Leverkusen and Bayern face a fascinating battle in the next month to see who can take the initiative before the Bundesliga takes its winter break in December. Stuttgart and Bayern clash in two weeks.
